$comment: Contract of the Auth setup blocks (escala-governance step 2): AuthPasskeySetup and AuthTwoFactorSetup, each on its own Figma page, with the parts those pages keep. Anatomy and variants mirror the Figma sets; nests lists every escala-ui component the block draws; motion lists each moving part with its role. A block draws no colour, length or type of its own (the QR's black on white is the one accepted exception).

blocks.name: AuthPasskeySetup
anatomy: Modal (Layout tray, Size lg 640, CloseVisible false: Surface/layer-1 shell, layer-2 panel)
ModalHeader (Align vertical-left, no icon, no description): Set up a passkey
Content slot: progress (3 ProgressLine xs, gap-tight) + step (fixed height 264, gap-group)
step intro: intro (heading-2xs + body-md) + benefits (3 x FeaturedIcon sm soft + title body-md + line body-sm)
step confirm: intro + AuthPasskeySetupIndicator + helper or error (Type/helper)
step saved: intro + passkey row (FeaturedIcon secondary, text, Badge success sm pill) + Field Passkey name (Input, Key icon)
ModalFooter (Layout inline): Leading = Step X of 3 (Type/caption, Content/secondary), Actions
behaviour: Controlled: type x status are the Figma axes; useAuthPasskeySetup({ create, save }) holds the flow
Create passkey calls create(signal) (the app's navigator.credentials.create()); a rejection is Status error, a resolution completed, then saved once save() settles
Back aborts the pending request; Back and Not now never lose what was typed
An undrawn pair draws the nearest variant: intro is always active, saved always completed
a11y: Rendered as the Modal: dialog role, focus trap and Escape when not inline; the header's title names the dialog and the step's sentence describes it
Focus moves to the step heading every time the step changes, never on the first paint in place
The progress strip is decorative (aria-hidden): the footer counter says the step in words
An inline error is announced (aria-live polite)

motion.mechanism: the Modal's own choreography (dialog-enter / exit); the card never moves
the step's content mounts transparent and settles (opacity + rise)
motion.reduced: fade kept, travel neutralised by the token

blocks.name: AuthPasskeySetupIndicator
anatomy: well (Surface/layer-1, Border/subtle, Radius/container, Spacing/inset-surface, gap-group, centred)
sensor: ProgressCircle lg (Value 25 active, 0 error, 100 completed) + glyph 24 centred (Fingerprint or Check; Content/accent, Status/critical/content on error)
caption: label (Type/body-md; Status/critical/content on error) + hint (Type/body-sm, Content/secondary), centred
a11y: The ring and the glyph are decorative (aria-hidden)
With onSensorClick (a simulated prompt) the sensor is a named button with the system's focus ring

motion.mechanism: the ring turns, one turn per cycle

blocks.name: AuthTwoFactorSetup
anatomy: Modal (Layout tray, Size lg 640, CloseVisible false)
ModalHeader (Align vertical-left, no icon, no description): Two-factor authentication
Content slot: progress (3 ProgressLine xs, gap-tight) + step (fixed height 232, gap-group)
step scan: _AuthTwoFactorSetupQR + details (intro, 2 app Badges secondary soft pill, hint + Input Type copy-link with the secret in Type/code), gap-section
step verify: intro + AuthTwoFactorSetupItem + InputOTP (Length 6, outline) + helper or error (Type/helper)
step backup: intro + AuthTwoFactorSetupGroup + actions (CheckboxItem secondary, Download and Copy secondary outline)
ModalFooter (Layout inline): Leading = Step X of 3, Actions
behaviour: Controlled: type x status are the Figma axes; useAuthTwoFactorSetup({ verify }) holds the flow
Verify is enabled at six digits; a wrong or expired code is Status error, cleared as soon as the person types
Turn on stays disabled until the acknowledgement is checked (backup: Status completed = checked)
Turn on reports onTurnOn: the app closes the dialog and confirms with a Toast
Download saves the codes as a text file, Copy writes them to the clipboard
The QR is generated from the otpauth link (qrcode-generator, error correction M); the same secret is always shown as copyable text
a11y: Rendered as the Modal: dialog role, focus trap and Escape when not inline
Focus moves to the step heading when the step changes, and to the first code slot on verify
The QR is an image with a name; the secret next to it is a labelled read-only field with a Copy button
The code field is marked invalid and tied to its error, which is announced (aria-live polite)

motion.mechanism: the Modal's own choreography (dialog-enter / exit); the card never moves
the step's content mounts transparent and settles (opacity + rise)
motion.reduced: fade kept, travel neutralised by the token

blocks.name: AuthTwoFactorSetupGroup
anatomy: well (Surface/layer-1, Border/subtle, Radius/container, Spacing/inset-surface)
2 rows x 4 codes (Type/code, Content/primary), column gap-group, row gap-control
a11y: A named list (ul) of selectable text: each code is announced and can be copied by hand

blocks.name: AuthTwoFactorSetupItem
anatomy: well (Surface/layer-1, Border/subtle, Radius/container, Spacing/inset-control, gap-group, centred)
logo (Avatar Type icon, Size sm, rounded, solid, Stack) + account (Type/body-md + Type/body-sm)
code (Type/heading-xs) + timer (ProgressCircle xs + Countdown Type/body-sm)
a11y: Demo only: a live product has no such row
The ring is decorative (aria-hidden); the seconds are the readable value
With onCodeClick the code is a named button with the system's focus ring
